points.place: 莫斯科省斯特列尔科夫卡村
points.title: 贫困童年
points.description: 朱可夫出生于莫斯科省斯特列尔科夫卡村一个贫困的农民家庭。他的父亲康斯坦丁是制革工人，母亲乌斯蒂尼亚是农民。朱可夫是家中长子，还有两个妹妹。由于家境贫寒，他只接受了初等教育，12岁就开始在莫斯科的一家毛皮店当学徒。这段艰苦的童年经历培养了他坚韧不拔的性格和对知识的渴望，为他后来的军事生涯奠定了基础。
points.descriptionEn: Zhukov was born in the village of Strelkovka in Moscow Governorate to a poor peasant family. His father Konstantin was a leatherworker and mother Ustinnya was a peasant. As the eldest of three children, Zhukov received only elementary education. At age 12, he began working as an apprentice in a fur shop in Moscow. This difficult childhood fostered his resilience and thirst for knowledge, laying the foundation for his later military career.

points.title: 参军入伍
points.description: 第一次世界大战期间，1915年，朱可夫应征入伍，被分配到骑兵部队。他在军事训练中表现出色，很快晋升为下士。1916年，他在西南战线参加了布鲁西洛夫攻势，因勇敢作战获得圣乔治十字勋章。十月革命后，他选择加入红军，在莫斯科附近与白军作战。这段军事经历使朱可夫积累了宝贵的实战经验，并展现了他的军事才能。
points.descriptionEn: During World War I, Zhukov was drafted in 1915 and assigned to a cavalry unit. He excelled in military training and was quickly promoted to corporal. In 1916, he participated in the Brusilov Offensive on the southwestern front and was awarded the Cross of St. George for bravery. After the October Revolution, he joined the Red Army and fought against White forces near Moscow. This military experience provided him with valuable combat experience and demonstrated his military talent.

points.title: 哈拉哈河战役
points.description: 1939年，朱可夫被派往蒙古指挥对日本关东军的作战。他精心策划了哈拉哈河战役，采用闪电战术和协同作战，以伤亡约9,000人的代价，歼灭日军约2万人，摧毁了日本第6集团军。这场战役的胜利迫使日本放弃北进计划，转而向南扩张，为苏联避免了在东西两线同时作战的危险。朱可夫的军事才能得到斯大林的高度认可，被授予苏联英雄称号，并晋升为大将。
points.descriptionEn: In 1939, Zhukov was sent to Mongolia to command operations against the Japanese Kwantung Army. He meticulously planned the Battle of Khalkhin Gol, employing blitz tactics and coordinated operations. At the cost of about 9,000 casualties, he annihilated approximately 20,000 Japanese troops and destroyed the Japanese 6th Army. This victory forced Japan to abandon its northern advance and turn southward, sparing the Soviet Union from the danger of fighting on two fronts. Zhukov's military talent earned him high recognition from Stalin, who awarded him the title of Hero of the Soviet Union and promoted him to the rank of general.

points.place: 莫斯科、斯大林格勒、柏林
points.title: 二战统帅
points.description: 二战期间，朱可夫成为苏联最杰出的军事指挥官。1941年，他指挥莫斯科保卫战，成功抵御德军进攻，粉碎了德军'台风'计划。1942-1943年，他担任斯大林格勒方面军总指挥，指挥了斯大林格勒战役，这是二战的转折点。1945年，他担任白俄罗斯第一方面军司令，指挥了柏林战役，攻克了德国首都。朱可夫在二战中指挥了苏联最关键的几场战役，为战胜纳粹德国做出了决定性贡献。他的军事才能和领导力在苏联乃至世界军事史上都占有重要地位。
points.descriptionEn: During World War II, Zhukov emerged as the Soviet Union's most outstanding military commander. In 1941, he commanded the defense of Moscow, successfully repelling the German offensive and thwarting Operation Typhoon. From 1942-1943, he served as commander of the Stalingrad Front, leading the Battle of Stalingrad, which marked a turning point in the war. In 1945, as commander of the 1st Belorussian Front, he led the Battle of Berlin, capturing the German capital. Zhukov commanded several of the Soviet Union's most critical battles during WWII, making decisive contributions to the defeat of Nazi Germany. His military talent and leadership occupy an important place in Soviet and world military history.

points.title: 战后巅峰
points.description: 二战后，朱可夫于1945年5月8日在柏林代表苏联接受德国无条件投降。1946年，他被任命为苏联武装力量总参谋长，但很快与斯大林发生冲突，被降职为敖德萨军区司令。斯大林去世后，朱可夫于1955年被任命为国防部长，1956年主持了镇压匈牙利事件的军事行动。1957年，赫鲁晓夫利用朱可夫对抗贝利亚，后又担心朱可夫权力过大，将其解职并强迫其退休。朱可夫的军事生涯达到顶峰后迅速衰落，但他作为二战英雄的地位已经确立。
points.descriptionEn: After WWII, Zhukov represented the Soviet Union in accepting Germany's unconditional surrender in Berlin on May 8, 1945. In 1946, he was appointed Chief of the General Staff of the Soviet Armed Forces but soon clashed with Stalin and was demoted to commander of the Odessa Military District. After Stalin's death, Zhukov was appointed Defense Minister in 1955 and commanded the military suppression of the Hungarian Revolution in 1956. In 1957, Khrushchev used Zhukov to counter Beria, but later feared his growing power and dismissed him, forcing him into retirement. Zhukov's military career rose rapidly to its peak then declined just as quickly, but his status as a WWII hero was already established.

points.title: 晚年岁月
points.description: 被解职后，朱可夫被软禁在莫斯科郊外，实际上处于半退休状态。他开始撰写回忆录，记录自己的军事生涯和二战经历。1964年，赫鲁晓夫下台后，朱可夫的政治地位有所恢复，被授予列宁勋章。1969年，他的回忆录《回忆与思考》出版，成为研究二战历史的重要资料。1974年，朱可夫在莫斯科逝世，享年78岁。他的葬礼有大量民众参加，显示了他作为二战英雄的崇高威望。朱可夫去世后，苏联政府为他建立了纪念馆，他的名字被永久铭刻在苏联军事史上。
points.descriptionEn: After his dismissal, Zhukov was placed under house arrest in Moscow's suburbs, effectively in semi-retirement. He began writing his memoirs, documenting his military career and WWII experiences. After Khrushchev's fall in 1964, Zhukov's political status somewhat improved, and he was awarded the Order of Lenin. In 1969, his memoirs 'Memoirs and Reflections' were published, becoming an important source for studying WWII history. Zhukov died in Moscow in 1974 at the age of 78. His funeral was attended by large crowds, demonstrating his prestige as a WWII hero. After his death, the Soviet government established a memorial museum in his honor, and his name was permanently engraved in Soviet military history.

appraisal.zh: 朱可夫被普遍视为二战中最杰出的军事统帅之一，指挥莫斯科保卫战、斯大林格勒战役和柏林战役，其军事才能对苏联军事理论影响深远，在俄罗斯更被当作民族英雄。也有研究者指出，他在基辅战役中未能及时撤退致苏军重大损失，对下属严厉无情，且作为斯大林体制的忠实执行者参与镇压，政治判断力与人道主义方面存在明显缺陷。
appraisal.en: Zhukov is generally regarded as one of the outstanding commanders of WWII, having led the defense of Moscow, Stalingrad and Berlin, with a military mind that deeply influenced Soviet theory; in Russia he is treated as a national hero. Researchers also note his failure to retreat in time at Kiev, causing heavy Soviet losses, his ruthlessness toward subordinates, and his role as a loyal executor of the Stalinist system who took part in suppressions, with clear flaws in political judgment and humanity.

supporter.zh: 朱可夫被支持者誉为苏联最伟大的军事统帅之一，是二战胜利的关键人物。他指挥了莫斯科保卫战、斯大林格勒战役和柏林战役等决定性战役，展现了卓越的军事才能和领导能力。朱可夫注重实际、重视士兵生命、善于运用现代战争战术，他的军事思想对苏联军事理论产生了深远影响。作为苏联英雄，他的功绩和贡献被载入史册，成为苏联爱国主义和军事荣耀的象征。
supporter.en: Supporters hail Zhukov as one of the greatest Soviet military commanders and a key figure in the victory of WWII. He led decisive battles including the defense of Moscow, the Battle of Stalingrad, and the Battle of Berlin, demonstrating exceptional military talent and leadership. Zhukov emphasized practicality, valued soldiers' lives, and excelled in applying modern warfare tactics, profoundly influencing Soviet military theory. As a Hero of the Soviet Union, his achievements and contributions are recorded in history, symbolizing Soviet patriotism and military glory.

critic.zh: 批评者指出朱可夫在军事决策中存在严重失误，如1941年基辅战役中未能及时撤退导致苏军重大损失。他对待下属严厉无情，曾下令处决撤退的士兵。在政治上，朱可夫是斯大林体制的忠实执行者，参与了镇压行动。战后，他虽然与赫鲁晓夫关系密切，但未能推动军队改革。批评者认为朱可夫虽然军事才能出众，但在政治判断力和人道主义方面存在明显缺陷，是斯大林时代军事官僚的代表人物。
critic.en: Critics point out serious errors in Zhukov's military decisions, such as his failure to retreat in time during the 1941 Kiev operation, leading to significant Soviet losses. He was harsh and ruthless toward subordinates, ordering the execution of retreating soldiers. Politically, Zhukov was a loyal executor of the Stalinist system and participated in suppression campaigns. After the war, although he had close ties with Khrushchev, he failed to promote military reform. Critics argue that despite his exceptional military talent, Zhukov had clear deficiencies in political judgment and humanitarianism, representing the military bureaucracy of the Stalin era.

objective.zh: 在历史学界和流行文化中，朱可夫被视为二战中最杰出的军事指挥官之一，其形象复杂而立体。西方历史学家承认他的军事才能，但也指出其政治局限性。在俄罗斯，朱可夫被视为民族英雄，他的雕像和纪念馆遍布全国。流行文化中，朱可夫的形象经常出现在电影、书籍和游戏中，成为苏联军事力量的象征。历史学界对他的评价逐渐从意识形态转向客观分析，既肯定他在战胜纳粹德国中的决定性作用，也承认他在斯大林体制中的角色和局限性。
objective.en: In historical scholarship and popular culture, Zhukov is regarded as one of the most outstanding military commanders of WWII, with a complex and multifaceted image. Western historians acknowledge his military talent but also point to his political limitations. In Russia, Zhukov is viewed as a national hero, with his statues and memorials found throughout the country. In popular culture, Zhukov frequently appears in films, books, and games, symbolizing Soviet military power. Historical evaluation of him has gradually shifted from ideological to objective analysis, both affirming his decisive role in defeating Nazi Germany and acknowledging his position and limitations within the Stalinist system.

self.zh: 胜利属于那些为祖国而战的人。
self.en: Victory belongs to those who have fought for their Motherland.
